# Argus

> Dark-web threat actor attribution platform. Unifies identities, PGP
> keys, wallets, infrastructure indicators, and behavioral evidence
> gathered from marketplace/forum sources into a single investigative
> graph, with AI-based stylometric and behavioral persona analysis
> contributing supporting (not standalone) attribution evidence.

Argus is an authenticated internal investigation tool, not a public
content site — there are no public pages for an LLM or crawler to read.
All data behind the login is real ingested intelligence (mock/synthetic
demo entries are explicitly labeled "SYNTHETIC / CONTROLLED" in the UI,
never mixed silently with real data). See /robots.txt: this site
requests exclusion from search indexing for the same reason.
